card.name: Website copyright and terms-of-use notices
card.fires_on: Words inside website copyright, licensing and terms-of-use statements, such as 'site', 'material', 'use', 'reproduced' and 'Attribution'. It also fires on disclaimer wording at the end of health pages.

modes.label: Copyright restrictions
modes.description: Words naming what may not be copied or reused, in legal-style site notices.
modes.example: REPRODUCE, REPUBLISH, UPLOAD, POST, TRANSMIT,OR DISTRIBUTE, IN ANY MANNER, THE MATERIAL ON THIS<< SITE>>. March 16, 2

modes.label: License and terms wording
modes.description: Words in Creative Commons credits or terms-of-use clauses.
modes.example: Users only in the way allowed by the specific Creative Commons Licence under which they have been submitted. Please see http://creativecommons.org for details. Any other<< use>> Please contact the copyright owners directly (

modes.label: Health page disclaimers
modes.description: Opening or key words of the disclaimer saying the page is not medical advice.
modes.example: Disclaimer:<< This>> article is not intended to provide medical advice

card.plain: It lights up on the legal fine print about copying, licensing and disclaimers at the bottom of web pages.
